behavior.name: bhvFloombaStartup
behavior.description: A Floomba that starts in the FLOOMBA_ACT_STARTUP state. It utilizes a custom animation speed derived from the first behavior parameter (BPARAM1 / 16.0) during its startup sequence.

field.name: Animation Speed
field.description: Multiplied by 1/16 to determine animation speed during startup.

field.name: Spawn Delay
field.description: Countdown timer before the object unhides.
